summary_en: Estee to tender all 339,000 PALTAC shares held as strategic investment to Medipal Holdings' tender offer at ¥6,650/share (¥2.254B total). Tender period 12 May – 7 July 2026; settlement 14 July 2026. Board endorsed; expects ¥1.794B gain on sale in FY3/27.
title_en: Notice Regarding Tender Offer Subscription and Expected Recording of Special Gains
translation_en_brief: On 19 June 2026, Estee's board resolved to tender all 339,000 ordinary shares of PALTAC Corporation (ticker 8283), held as a strategic investment, to a tender offer launched by Medipal Holdings Corporation (Estee's parent company). The offer price is ¥6,650 per share, yielding total proceeds of ¥2.254 billion. The tender period runs from 12 May to 7 July 2026, with settlement on 14 July 2026. Estee's board endorsed the offer after concluding that the price and terms were fair, and noting PALTAC's board support. If all shares are tendered and sold as planned during the FY3/27 fiscal year, Estee expects to record ¥1.794 billion in investment gains (特別利益) in consolidated and standalone results for that period.
